symptom: A naturally scheduled N2 readiness run failed its evidence-building step in about one second, but the job lasted about ten minutes and the Post Checkout step remained in_progress/null in the completed job metadata. The full job log returned HTTP 404 BlobNotFound. An earlier natural run had the same failing step but a full log proving DAILY_PLAN_MISSING and exit 3, with completed cleanup.
lesson: An early research payload failure and a prolonged unresolved post-job phase can coexist. A prior missing-plan payload cause must not be copied to a later run without its own process log; a completed job with an in_progress post-step and an unavailable log does not by itself prove a runner crash or platform root cause.
guardrail: For natural N2 red runs, separate payload, process exit, workflow/job conclusion, post-job cleanup, and runner/platform evidence. Compare job-step timestamps and full logs when available. With BlobNotFound, keep later payload exit and cleanup/runner cause unknown, do not infer readiness, and do not activate or rerun protected N2 for diagnostics. Reuse the missing-day-index guardrail only when the matching payload evidence exists.
